text:
This notice should be read with:

Standard 3.1 of the Maritime Labour Convention, 2006 and the Merchant Shipping (Maritime Labour Convention) (Minimum Requirements for Seafarers etc.) Regulations 2014 (S.I. 2014/1613)

MSN 1844 (M) amendment 1 MLC, 2006: crew accommodation

MGN 707 (M) MLC 2006 - provision of social connectivity and internet access

This notice replaces MGN 481 (M) Amendment 1. It includes the new social connectivity requirement and updates reference information.

Notice to:

shipnowners

ship operators

ship managers

employers of seafarers

masters

officers

seafarers on seagoing ships ordinarily engaged in commercial operations

ship builders

yacht builders
